name: Ledger
description: A Handlebars (Tier-2 / handlebars) demonstrator: an index-card front page whose entry list is authored with Handlebars block helpers ({{#each}}, {{#if}}, {{#unless}}) and whose header/footer come from Tovu's shared component registry via the {{render_block}} seam. Proves the Handlebars tier end-to-end — escaped output everywhere except the one sanctioned {{{post.content}}} raw seam, no partials, no decorators, no custom helpers. Executes no theme JavaScript.
